Workspace

Location %

Drop a BOQ on the drop zone above. Manage supplier pricelists in the Pricelists tab; matching lines are priced automatically. Drag ⠿ or use ▲ ▼ to reorder rows (a row takes the section of the row above it), ＋ inserts a row below any row, and the arrows on a section heading move the whole section. On a new row, type a product name, part number or what you need into Description and pick it from the list. Rates you type are remembered in your rate book and applied automatically to matching lines on later imports. ⚑ marks lines with an assumption note or a missing rate.

Tender submission checklist

Drag files onto this panel to log them as ready. Only the file name is recorded; keep the files in your own folder or on the tender portal.

Import from your CCTV design tool

Export the design or BoQ from your design tool (Excel, CSV, PDF or JSON) and drop it here. The lines go into the BoQ under "CCTV design" and are priced from your pricelists and the supplier catalogs. The file is also logged in the drawing register.

A simple, fast process

1

Upload your BOQ

Drag and drop a PDF, Excel or CSV. Headers, footers and bill totals are skipped.
2

Structure & price

Lines are grouped by trade with units kept. Rates come from your rate book; everything stays editable.
3

Export & submit

Choose your mark-up, then export an Excel or CSV schedule and tick off your tender documents.
